# Test Video: Building a CLI Tool in Python

**Video URL:** https://youtube.com/watch?v=test123

## Summary

This video demonstrates how to build a command-line interface (CLI) tool in Python using the argparse module. We cover argument parsing, subcommands, and best practices for creating user-friendly CLI applications.

## Key Points

- Use argparse for standard library CLI parsing
- Subcommands allow organizing complex tools
- Type hints improve code clarity and IDE support
- Help text should be descriptive and examples help users
- Exit codes should follow conventions (0 for success, non-zero for errors)

## Technical Details

The implementation uses a modular approach with separate functions for each subcommand, making the code easy to test and maintain.
